title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 012
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute wallet variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Folded wallet with a front strap flap and a round snap button
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic folded wallet with a visible fastening strap.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for pouches or open top wallets when the strap and snap are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected wallet with a front strap flap crossing the body.

items.depicts_observation: Money pouch outline with a top ring and centered currency mark
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tied money pouch instead of a flat folding wallet.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rectangular wallet styles when the tied bag silhouette matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot swaps the wallet body for a rounded pouch with a tied top and currency mark.

items.depicts_observation: Open top wallet outline with a back flap and one front dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a flat wallet that looks open at the top edge.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for angled or clasp wallets when the top flap and front dot are the key cues.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a straight rectangular wallet with a back flap peeking above the front face.

items.depicts_observation: Angled wallet outline with a slanted flap and one front dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a wallet shown in slight perspective with a lifted flap.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flat open wallet when the slanted flap angle should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from wallet_3 by showing the flap at a clear diagonal perspective.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded rectangular wallet outline with a front slot panel and centered clasp notch
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a compact wallet with a front slot and a centered clasp cutout.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for strap or pouch wallets when the front slot and clasp notch matter visually.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a rounded case shape with a centered slot notch instead of a fold or pouch.
